card.name: Spots where "concrete" is about to be written
card.fires_on: The position just before a word that begins "con-" or is likely to be "concrete", such as the start of concretised, concretely, concomitant or concrete results. It also fires on words like "few", "more" or an opening quote where "concrete" could come next.

modes.description: A word after which "concrete" would fit, as in "few concrete results" or "more concrete study".

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with con- or cre- word beginnings and suppresses the word concrete (the building material) in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It fires when the next word is likely to start with "con", especially "concrete" in the sense of definite, not the building material.
